title: Qabala kurruuma mooyat
intro: taswiir fidin weeqi ardi bagul fayya iyya, Arki leeh amol gexa, kee inki rooci dooritik irol raqte. qabalat axawah tan farmoytit uxih baxsimteh tan imaanal, ta muuci foocal ellecabo seeco booxal tamaatem lee fayya inte wak. Atu cinek derret tan kinnaane qaddossam duuddaa?
clues: Anu Yallih naba farmoytit fanak numuk teynah samada kinniyo, Anu cabam doorite buxah mara kinniyo.
Anu elle waarem kaxxa weeqi wakti, kufri leeh innah baaxo buuleh yan wak.
Anu yi abba yoh seece wak muuminiin lih doonik safar cineh.
Anu excem Anu qalel dabboh gorriseyyo leek yoo dacrisoonuh.
Yoo warseenih Yallih madqak woo ayr racmatta akke waytek tu malim yoh wariseenih.
Anu mooyat radeeh, culeeh, yabba anu kay buxah mara hinniyom yoh warseenih.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
